channel.title: K C B Inc - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from K C B Inc (kcbs.com)

item.title: Scores of U.S. warplanes head for key bases amid standoff with Iran
item.description: As Trump pressures Iran, he's spoken of an "armada" heading for the Mideast, but there's another massive movement of American fire power in the air.

item.title: Judge holds DOJ lawyer in contempt as tensions flare over immigration cases
item.description: A Minnesota federal judge ordered a government attorney to be held in civil contempt of court, further escalating tension between the judiciary and Trump administration over immigration cases.

item.title: California avalanche survivors tried to unbury their friends, official says
item.description: The avalanche, the deadliest in California history, killed at least eight people and left a ninth person missing.

item.title: Artemis II moon rocket refueled in practice countdown setting stage for historic flight
item.description: Engineers were able to fully fuel NASA's Artemis II moon rocket without any signs of leaks like the ones that derailed an earlier dress rehearsal.

item.title: One Question | Meet the top candidates for California governor
item.description: Julie Watts interviewed every candidate for California governor ahead of next year's election.

item.title: U.S. fighter jets intercept Russian warplanes off Alaskan coast
item.description: Two Russian Tu-95s bombers, two Su-35s fighter planes and an A-50 spy plane were detected in the Alaskan Air Defense Identification Zone, NORAD said.

item.title: Eric Dane, "Grey's Anatomy" star diagnosed with ALS, dies at 53
item.description: In April 2025, Eric Dane announced he had been diagnosed​ with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, or ALS.

item.title: The Brighton Ax Murder
item.description: A young mother is killed in her bed, her toddler unharmed. Unsolved for 40 years, how the unusual crime scene helped close the case. "48 Hours" correspondent Erin Moriarty reports. (This is a 26-minute episode.)

item.title: Who Killed Aileen Seiden in Room 15?
item.description: Three people check into a Florida motel room. Only two walk out alive. "48 Hours" correspondent Peter Van Sant reports.

item.title: Some victims of California avalanche near Lake Tahoe identified by families
item.description: The identities of some of the victims of the deadly California avalanche near Lake Tahoe became known on Thursday.
